digest.component_or_area: Plan-Review LLM caching and prompt architecture
propositions: Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier prompts must share a byte-identical plan-bearing prefix to enable Anthropic's provider-side cache reuse within the ephemeral 5-minute TTL window and within a single pass (verifier chunks sharing one cache entry)

The shared prefix is single-sourced in prompts.SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE + shared_plan_prefix() to enforce byte identity across all renderers and prevent drift, eliminating duplicate preamble in templates
Pass-1 verifier prompts must include an exhaustiveness directive bullet ('enumerate EVERY independent defect…') in their shared stance to prevent deferred findings in incremental-depth BLOCK loops

The plan must move from verifier user message (post-volatile-marker) into verifier system prompt by removing the volatile marker and leading with {{shared_prefix}}, while per-run finding listings remain user-turn via base_instructions
The Pass-1 warm gate must measure est_tokens(shared_plan_prefix(plan)) >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS (4096) rather than est_tokens(plan) alone to gate on the actual bytes sent to the model for caching

plan_review_verify_inputs must emit shared_prefix instead of plan, plan-review.yaml both verify steps must wire shared_prefix from verify_inputs outputs, and plan-review-verifier must exit RELOCATED_PROMPTS since it no longer carries the volatile split marker
